div.p: Discover the lost streets of south-west Carlton. Before the University of Melbourne extended its footprint across this broader precinct from the later part of the twentieth century, the blocks between Grattan, Swanston, Victoria and Elizabeth streets were home to working families, shops, pubs, factories, churches and schools. The Common Ground Project brings their stories back to light.
We’ve drawn on electoral rolls, city directories, rate books, maps and a range of other archives to build a searchable record of who lived and worked here.

div.p: This history belongs to the community, and it’s still being written. Know something we’ve missed? Update an entry, share a family story, or suggest a new entry.
